title: HIRING! Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist Fully Remote
content: HIRING! Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist Fully Remote https://work.turing.com/r/BpA6o2F8Jm Role Overview We are looking for talented Illustrators, Sketchers, Cartoonists, Digital Artists, and Concept Artists who can create high-quality artwork from reference images while introducing creative variations and maintaining the character’s identity. This opportunity is open to interns, freshers, emerging artists, and experienced professionals with strong visual skills and a portfolio that demonstrates creativity, versatility, and attention to detail. What You’ll Do 1. Create digital character illustrations and sketches using provided reference images. 2. Produce creative variations while maintaining character identity and visual consistency. 3. Apply core fundamentals of composition, color, lighting, perspective, and proportion. 4. Adapt artwork across diverse visual themes based on project requirements. 5. Document creative decisions, style choices, and simple prompt metadata. 6. Deliver polished, high-quality artwork within assigned project timelines.

title: WE'RE HIRING! ILLUSTRATORS, SKETCHERS & CARTOONISTS!
content: WE'RE HIRING! ILLUSTRATORS, SKETCHERS & CARTOONISTS! TRABAHERO PH | Your Next Opportunity Starts Here! Are you passionate about digital art, character design, or creative illustration? Turing is looking for talented artists to contribute to an exciting AI project! Interns, fresh graduates, emerging artists, and experienced professionals are welcome! JOB DETAILS Company: Turing Position: Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist Location: Fully Remote Compensation: Paid in USD (per approved task; rate not specified) Project Duration: 10–12 weeks Commitment: 20–40 hours/week Start: After onboarding and portfolio approval REQUIRED SKILLS Adobe Illustrator / Photoshop Digital Illustration & Sketching Character Design & Cartooning Composition, Color & Perspective Creativity & Attention to Detail QUALIFICATIONS Strong art portfolio showcasing your skills Experience with Procreate, Clip Studio Paint, Affinity, or similar tools Ability to maintain character consistency across different styles Familiarity with surreal, cinematic, retro, steampunk, or other visual styles is a plus Able to work independently and meet deadlines YOUR ROLE Create high-quality character illustrations from references. Develop creative variations while preserving character identity. Adapt artwork to different artistic styles. Refine designs based on project feedback. Document creative choices and submit polished artwork. HOW TO APPLY trabaheroph@gmail.com Subject: Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist Attach your updated CV and art portfolio (Behance, ArtStation, Google Drive, or personal website). Shortlisted applicants will undergo portfolio review before onboarding.

title: LOOKING FOR AN ARTIST! Character art cards for books
content: LOOKING FOR AN ARTIST! I’m looking for an artist to work with one of my author clients on character art cards for multiple books. We have quite a few projects in the works, so I’d love to connect with someone interested in an ongoing working relationship and multiple commissions! Here’s what we’re looking for: - Character art/cards for books - Budget: Under $100 per art piece - Multiple pieces across multiple books - Must be available to start now! - NO AI-GENERATED ART. Human artists only, please! If you’re an artist whose style might be a good fit, please drop your portfolio or commission sheet in the comments, along with your pricing and current availability! If you know an artist who might be interested, please tag them or share this post. We’d love to find someone whose art we can keep coming back to as these projects grow!
